answer: Davies repaid £33,425 from £23,395 loaned, avoiding jail despite threats.
evidence: ["L Davies, 58, from Neath, was given a deal by Cardiff Crown Court judge Patrick Curran QC in October and given six months to repay the cash. The court heard on Friday Davies had paid up before the deadline and his jail term was suspended for two years.", "Davies, who threatened his victims if they did not pay, was caught out after an anonymous tip-off to the Wales Illegal Money Leading Unit."]
